test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is constructed by folding the given sheet along the lines shown. In the cube so formed, what would be the word on the opposite side of 'Ball'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784f10312b19f3c686a5841d2f7345769295d0b4776d6ecb1c80ba42b774391e.png]
solution:
To find the opposite surface of 'Ball', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f84aedbf383844c7de547c6046d1607fd4febf6d4115e1c67074474f8213be4b.png] 

Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other in open dice.

Bat is opposite to Stick.

Net is opposite to Goal.

So, Field is opposite to Ball.

Hence, the correct answer is "Field".
